nodes.rationale: Brand accent gradient used on the selected Dark segment and the MONETIC wordmark, over a navy-to-plum dark background with rounded card sections.

nodes.label: Repeat Monthly Budget Toggle
nodes.rationale: When enabled, carries the same budget amount forward each month; when off (as shown), the user is prompted to set a new budget at the start of each month.

nodes.label: Dark-Mode-First Design
nodes.rationale: On-screen copy states 'Monetic is designed for dark mode. Light mode is fully supported if you prefer it.' Dark is the default/selected theme, with Light and System offered as alternatives.

nodes.label: Dark Gradient Glass UI Theme with Gradient Wordmark
nodes.norm_label: dark gradient glass ui theme with gradient wordmark
nodes.rationale: Navy-to-purple background, translucent circular/pill floating buttons and blue-purple gradient MONETIC wordmark give a premium, cohesive brand look for App Store previews.

nodes.label: Group Row Card (emoji icon, name, expense count, total, chevron)
nodes.norm_label: group row card (emoji icon, name, expense count, total, chevron)
nodes.rationale: Each group is a rounded dark card with a tinted emoji tile, title, expense count subtitle and right-aligned total; zero-total groups are dimmed to de-emphasize empty categories, and the chevron signals drill-down into group detail.

nodes.label: Group Picker (emoji category chips: Bills & Fees, Entertainment, Food & Dining, Health)
nodes.norm_label: group picker (emoji category chips: bills & fees, entertainment, food & dining, health)

nodes.label: Dark Gradient Card-Based UI Style
nodes.rationale: Each input (amount, group, date+note) sits in its own rounded dark card with uppercase tracked section labels, giving a calm, scannable form; amount is the dominant element and the decimal keypad is pre-focused so the fastest path to logging an expense is typing a number.

nodes.label: Per-Month Budgeting Model
nodes.rationale: Budget is scoped to a specific calendar month (prompt: 'How much do you plan to spend in September 2026?'), implying budgets are stored and set per month.

nodes.label: Save Budget Button (disabled until amount entered)
nodes.norm_label: save budget button (disabled until amount entered)

nodes.label: Dark Navy-to-Purple Gradient Sheet Design
nodes.rationale: Single-question modal sheet with minimal chrome focuses the user on one decision (monthly spend target); muted gradient and oversized numeral give a calm, premium feel for a budgeting app's first-run flow.

nodes.label: Add Expense Gradient CTA Button
nodes.rationale: Bottom-anchored full-width button with blue-to-magenta gradient keeps the primary action reachable within the category context.

nodes.label: Category Detail Sheet (Food & Dining)
nodes.rationale: Modal sheet with Done button, category title, and ellipsis overflow menu; scoped view of a single spending category.

nodes.label: Category Summary Card (emoji icon, expense count, This Month total)
nodes.norm_label: category summary card (emoji icon, expense count, this month total)
nodes.rationale: Header card pairs an emoji category icon with expense count and a THIS MONTH total ($24.50) to give at-a-glance monthly spend.

nodes.label: App Preview 04: Category Detail Screen
nodes.rationale: Marketing App Store preview showing per-category drill-down: a modal sheet that summarizes one category's monthly spend and lists its expenses, with a prominent gradient CTA to add more.

nodes.label: Dark Navy-to-Purple Gradient Visual Theme
nodes.rationale: Dark background fading navy to purple with rounded translucent cards; consistent premium dark aesthetic across app previews.

nodes.label: Expense Category Groups (Bills & Fees, Food & Dining, Health, Entertainment)
nodes.norm_label: expense category groups (bills & fees, food & dining, health, entertainment)
nodes.rationale: Sample data: Bills & Fees $89.00 (coral), Food & Dining $24.50 (amber), Health $12.50 (blue), Entertainment $8.99 (purple); groups roll up individual categories for overview charts.

nodes.label: App Preview 03: Dashboard Screen
nodes.rationale: App Store marketing preview showing the main Monetic dashboard in dark mode: a monthly budget ring (remaining amount front and center) above a spending-by-group donut chart, communicating at-a-glance budget health.

nodes.label: Monetic Header Bar (Settings, Edit, Add)
nodes.rationale: Gradient MONETIC wordmark centered with a settings gear on the left and Edit plus a prominent blue + (add expense) button on the right; primary action is adding a transaction.

nodes.label: Monthly Budget Ring Card (Remaining / Spent / Budget)
nodes.norm_label: monthly budget ring card (remaining / spent / budget)
nodes.rationale: Card for September 2026 with a circular progress ring showing $2,365.01 remaining (5% used), with Spent $134.99 and Budget $2,500.00 below; a filter/sliders button sits in the card corner. Emphasizes remaining budget over spent amount.

nodes.label: Spending Overview: By Group Donut Chart
nodes.norm_label: spending overview: by group donut chart
nodes.rationale: Collapsible Spending Overview section with a segmented donut chart totaling $134.99 and a color-coded legend of category groups with amounts.

nodes.label: Dark Navy-to-Purple Gradient Theme
nodes.rationale: Dark background gradient with rounded dark cards, letter-spaced uppercase section labels, and a blue-to-purple gradient wordmark; consistent visual language across the marketing previews.

nodes.label: Dark Navy-to-Purple Gradient Card UI Style
nodes.norm_label: dark navy-to-purple gradient card ui style
nodes.rationale: Rounded dark cards on a gradient background with large bold currency figures and color-coded donut segments keep the focus on remaining budget and where money went at a glance.

nodes.label: Ribbon / Flowing Money Motif
nodes.rationale: A curved ribbon sweeps upward inside the M, suggesting growth and the flow of money; ambiguous whether it is also meant to read as a stylized lowercase 'p' or rising chart line.

nodes.label: Blue-to-Purple Brand Gradient
nodes.rationale: Left-to-right gradient from bright cyan/azure blue through indigo to violet/magenta-purple, with depth shading on the folds; displayed on a black background, indicating the mark is designed for dark surfaces.

nodes.label: Stylized 'M' Monogram with Ribbon Swoosh
nodes.rationale: Rounded, folded-ribbon M whose inner stroke sweeps upward like a rising flag/curve, suggesting growth and money moving forward; reads as a standalone mark without the wordmark, suited to app icons and avatars.

nodes.label: Blue-to-Purple Gradient Brand Palette
nodes.rationale: Cyan/blue to violet/magenta gradient on pure black gives a modern, dark-mode-friendly fintech look.

nodes.label: Stylized M Monogram Logo
nodes.rationale: Folded-ribbon M with an inner flowing swoosh, suggesting motion and money flow for a currency/finance app; reads well at small icon sizes on a black background.

nodes.norm_label: brand.swift (tokens: colors, surfaces, type, radii, spacing)

nodes.norm_label: brandcomponents.swift (cards, buttons, budget ring, progress bars, segmented control, amount field)

nodes.norm_label: categorypalette.swift (nine group hues + legacy color-name mapping)

nodes.label: Early-access waitlist form (mailto)
nodes.rationale: Opens visitor's email client because there is no backend to store submissions yet.

nodes.label: Monetic marketing landing page
nodes.rationale: Single self-contained HTML page, no build step; pre-launch, hosted as private Claude artifact pending a real domain. Typography (Fraunces/Sora/JetBrains Mono) differs from app to allow a more editorial feel; colors sampled from real UI and logo.

nodes.label: Monetic iOS budgeting app
nodes.rationale: Simple, less overwhelming budgeting focused on the core habit of staying aware of monthly spending rather than a full finance platform.

nodes.label: Blue-violet-magenta brand gradient
nodes.rationale: Taken from the logo; reserved for signature moments (budget ring, primary buttons, wordmark, selection) so it reads as a brand mark, not decoration.

nodes.label: Budget Rollover (Repeat Monthly Budget)
nodes.rationale: No longer silently carries the old budget forward; explicit 'Roll Over Last Month's Budget ($X)' prompt and a Settings row make the carried amount visible and reapplicable.

nodes.label: Dark mode as default
nodes.rationale: Brand is tuned for dark; light mode supported via Settings.

nodes.label: Monetic Design System
nodes.rationale: Single design system instead of SwiftUI defaults; every surface declared once and resolved per interface style.

nodes.label: K-12 early financial literacy goal
nodes.rationale: Budgeting, tracking spending, and seeing where money goes are skills best started young; app keeps first steps simple for students.

nodes.label: Selectable Category Card Row
nodes.rationale: Each row is a rounded card with an emoji icon tile, a label and a purple checkmark toggle. The border and icon tile are tinted with a color specific to the category.

nodes.label: Onboarding Category Group Picker
nodes.rationale: First-run screen asks the user to pick the spending groups to start with; copy 'You can change these any time' lowers commitment. All groups are pre-selected by default (7 groups selected), so a user can tap Get Started without configuring anything.

nodes.label: Get Started CTA with Selection Count
nodes.norm_label: get started cta with selection count
nodes.rationale: A pinned bottom gradient button stays visible while the list scrolls. Below it, a live counter reads '7 groups selected'. A seventh category is partly cut off, which suggests there is more to scroll.

nodes.label: Monetic Brand Identity (M icon, blue-purple-magenta gradient)
nodes.norm_label: monetic brand identity (m icon, blue-purple-magenta gradient)
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square 'M' app icon and letter-spaced MONETIC wordmark sit on a dark navy background. The blue-to-magenta gradient is reused on the Get Started CTA.
